"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for the independence and stability of the states of the former Soviet Union, based on the belief that a prosperous and stable neighborhood will reinforce Russia's integration into the Euro-Atlantic community.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
